saw_lines: Basics get replaced in packs and reordered in the same cut, so most buyers never browse for something new.
So a reorder is won or lost in the first line, when a buyer decides if the offer is worth a click.
Your site offers a first order discount, yet only 3 of 27 ads mention it. Put that discount in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 4 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers a first order discount, yet only 3 of 27 ads mention it, so a new buyer sees no reason to act. Put that discount in the first line of three new ads and repeat it on the creative.

The site advertises subscribe and save, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription, so buyers who would reorder have nothing to sign up for. Run two retention ads with subscribe and save as the headline, aimed at past buyers.
None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so buyers have no count to trust. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch of ads with it.

15 ads have run 60+ days, yet none of the 15 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line, so each new ad starts from zero. Build the next three ads as variations of your oldest winner, keeping its opening line.

ads_1: Offer-led variations of your oldest winner, opening with the first order discount
